messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for generation API (us-west). 5xx spike observed across gen queue starting ~09:11 UTC. Paging on-call: @alice-oncall. Runbook: /runbooks/gen-5xx.

alice-oncall: Ack. Oncall here — starting triage. Collecting logs and traces, will post initial customer-facing snippet in thread.

ben-eng: Noted. I'm pulling genqueue logs and router traces now. Hypothesis: sudden backend gRPC timeouts to model pool 3 in us-west.

frank-sre: I see KV cache thrash and increased latency on pool-3 hosts. Rolling availability degraded to 60% for the pool.

alice-oncall: Quick mitigation plan: 1) route new requests away from pool-3 to pool-1/2 (warm capacity) 2) roll back last network config change from 09:05 UTC if routing doesn't help, 3) statuspost draft for customers. Assigning: @ben-eng to route, @frank-sre to monitor.

ben-eng: Routing rule applied to send traffic away from pool-3 -> pool-1/2. Warm pools absorbing traffic, error rate dropping from 18% -> 6% within 3 mins. Continuing metric watch.

carla-comms: Drafting status post now. Keeping short and factual. Posting draft below for quick review:

```
We are investigating elevated errors affecting generation endpoints in the US West region. Some requests may fail with 5xx. Our engineers are routing traffic to healthy capacity and working toward a full fix.

Impacted: customers using generation endpoints in us-west.
Estimated next update: in 20 minutes or when more info is available.
```

alice-oncall: +1 on tone. Small edit: add "no data loss" line. Also add guidance for SDK retry/backoff.

carla-comms: Updated draft: 

```
We are investigating elevated errors affecting generation endpoints in the US West region. Some requests may fail with 5xx. Our engineers have routed traffic to healthy capacity and are actively investigating the root cause.

Impacted: customers using generation endpoints in us-west.
We have no evidence of data loss.
Guidance: transient 5xx errors may occur — please retry with exponential backoff.

Next update: ~20 minutes or sooner as we have updates.
```

dave-legal: Avoid promising no data loss unless CS confirms. Suggest: "No evidence of data loss at this time."

eva-cs: Confirming no customer data reported missing so far. "No evidence" language is fine.

carla-comms: Finalizing with legal tweak. Posting to status now. Copy below for record: 

"We are investigating elevated errors affecting generation endpoints in the US West region. Some requests may fail with 5xx. Our engineers have routed traffic to healthy capacity and are actively investigating the root cause. Impacted: customers using generation endpoints in us-west. No evidence of data loss at this time. Guidance: transient 5xx errors may occur — please retry with exponential backoff. Next update: ~20 minutes or sooner."

alice-oncall: Thanks. Status posted. Linking: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-0315-usw-gen 

ben-eng: Root cause narrowed: config propagation to edge routers caused stale route table to send KV cache-heavy traffic to pool-3, causing overload. Reverted propagation and added short-lived route to disperse traffic.

frank-sre: Error rate back to normal range (~0.8%). Latency stable. Monitoring for 10 more minutes then we'll mark mitigated.

carla-comms: Sending second public update: short note that we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. Draft: 

"Update: We have applied routing mitigations which have reduced errors for generation endpoints in US West. Traffic is now routing to healthy capacity. We are monitoring and will provide a final update when the issue is resolved."

alice-oncall: OK to publish.

carla-comms: Published.

ben-eng: Follow-up actions: create a short postmortem entry, add a guardrail to avoid config propagation during high-traffic windows, and add alert for rapid KV cache eviction spikes.

alice-oncall: Agreed. I'll open the incident tracker and assign action items.

frank-sre: Monitoring stable for 12 minutes. No regression. Ready to resolve after 20m confirmation window.

carla-comms: Final resolved copy for status page: 

"Resolved: The routing issue that caused elevated errors for generation endpoints in US West has been mitigated. Traffic is routing to healthy capacity and error rates have returned to normal. We have no evidence of data loss. We will follow up with a post-incident report outlining root cause and next steps."

alice-oncall: Publishing resolved now. Closing page.

eva-cs: Notifying affected customers with the follow-up note and link to postmortem when available.

dave-legal: Thanks everyone — please include the factual timeline in the postmortem for the compliance audit.

frank-sre: Incident closed from on-call perspective. Logging metrics and saving traces to the incident ticket.

alice-oncall: Thanks team. Postmortem assignee: @ben-eng. ETA for report: 72 hours.

carla-comms: I'll draft the customer-facing postmortem blurb once Ben posts the tech postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: Mitigation confirmed and status page updated to Resolved.
